title: Battery widget freezes plasmashell at 100% CPU when an app leaks many power inhibitions
line: An app that leaks thousands of identical sleep inhibitions no longer pegs plasmashell or clogs its D-Bus: the battery popup shows it once and Unblock works.
explanation: Each inhibition an app holds became its own row in the battery popup, the row list was rebuilt from scratch on every change, and every row did its own app lookup. With a few thousand identical leaked inhibitions (LocalSend, Firefox) plasmashell spent all its time rebuilding rows, used over 1 GB and froze the panel. Separately, every change notification made the applet fetch the whole list again, so hundreds of changes at once (blocking the leaked app, or many inhibitions starting together) sent hundreds of large D-Bus requests that clogged plasmashell's D-Bus connection for good. The first commit (the change of open MR powerdevil!702) shows identical inhibitions once; the second keeps one list request in flight and repeats it only if more changes came in meanwhile.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: collapse duplicate inhibitions

An app that keeps requesting the same inhibition without releasing it
got one popup entry per request, and the list was rebuilt on every
change, so a few hundred of them kept plasmashell busy. Keep only one.

BUG: 526663

media.caption: Master, 2233 identical localsend_app inhibitions held plus one every 20 s, plasmashell restarted: clicking the battery icon and the launcher does nothing and the clock is stuck at 12:49 (real time 00:51); plasmashell used 90 s of CPU in 90 s and grew to 1.2 GB.
Same steps with the fix: the battery popup opens with a single localsend_app entry, then the launcher opens; plasmashell used 1 s of CPU in 90 s and stays at 360 MB.
Master, end of the same run: no popup opened and the clock still shows 12:49 at 00:51.
With the fix: the 2233 identical inhibitions show as one 'localsend_app is blocking sleep' row.
With the fix: Unblock on that row blocks all 2235 leaked inhibitions at once and the row turns to Allow; plasmashell answers D-Bus normally.
